::: home-more
## Research in brief

On one side, extremal and probabilistic questions about graphs and hypergraphs: colourings, Ramsey numbers, embeddings, sparse regularity. On the other, what learning algorithms (best-response dynamics, no-regret learners, reinforcement learning) actually do when they play games against each other. The [research page](Research/research.qmd) has papers, talks and open projects; the [teaching page](Teaching/Teaching.qmd) collects course material.

## Besides research

-   Leading a cross-field project for an EU proposal of new regulations regarding nutritional information on food packaging.
-   Contributing to a project for Carbon Credit Assessment, in collaboration with a Swiss startup.
-   Writing a cookbook with all my family's traditional recipes.
-   Training for the Barcelona marathon (March 2027).
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var canvas = document.getElementById('sbrd');
  if (!canvas) return;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('sbrd-status');
  var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var M = 10;                       // actions per player
  var psi, ne, path, outcome, cycleAt, timer = null;

  function css(n) { return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(n).trim() || '#888'; }
  function hex(h) { h = h.replace('#', ''); if (h.length === 3) h = h.split('').map(function (c) { return c + c; }).join(''); return [0, 2, 4].map(function (i) { return parseInt(h.substr(i, 2), 16); }); }
  function mix(a, b, t) { var A = hex(a), B = hex(b); return 'rgb(' + A.map(function (v, i) { return Math.round(v + (B[i] - v) * t); }).join(',') + ')'; }
  function gauss() { var u = 1 - Math.random(), v = Math.random(); return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v); }

  function br1(b) { var best = 0; for (var i = 1; i < M; i++) if (psi[i][b] > psi[best][b]) best = i; return best; }   // player 1 picks a row
  function br2(a) { var best = 0; for (var j = 1; j < M; j++) if (psi[a][j] > psi[a][best]) best = j; return best; }   // player 2 picks a column

  function newGame() {
    psi = []; for (var i = 0; i < M; i++) { psi.push([]); for (var j = 0; j < M; j++) psi[i].push(gauss()); }
    // rank-normalise for shading
    var flat = []; psi.forEach(function (r) { flat = flat.concat(r); }); flat.sort(function (x, y) { return x - y; });
    psi.rank = psi.map(function (r) { return r.map(function (v) { return flat.indexOf(v) / (flat.length - 1); }); });
    ne = []; for (i = 0; i < M; i++) for (j = 0; j < M; j++) if (br1(j) === i && br2(i) === j) ne.push([i, j]);
    path = [[Math.floor(Math.random() * M), Math.floor(Math.random() * M)]];
    outcome = null; cycleAt = -1;
  }

  function advance() {
    var cur = path[path.length - 1], nxt = [br1(cur[1]), br2(cur[0])];
    path.push(nxt);
    var n = path.length;
    if (!outcome) {
      if (nxt[0] === cur[0] && nxt[1] === cur[1]) { outcome = 'ne'; cycleAt = n - 2; }
      else if (n >= 3 && nxt[0] === path[n - 3][0] && nxt[1] === path[n - 3][1]) { outcome = 'cycle'; cycleAt = n - 3; }
    }
  }

  function geometry() {
    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), w = r.width, h = r.height;
    var pad = Math.max(18, w * 0.05), side = Math.min(w - 2 * pad, h - 2 * pad);
    return { w: w, h: h, cell: side / M, x0: (w - side) / 2 + 6, y0: (h - side) / 2 };
  }
  function centre(g, p) { return [g.x0 + (p[1] + 0.5) * g.cell, g.y0 + (p[0] + 0.5) * g.cell]; }

  function draw() {
    var g = geometry(); if (!g.w || !psi) return;
    var lo = css('--dm-surface'), hi = css('--dm-teal'), ink = css('--dm-ink'), muted = css('--dm-muted'),
        plum = css('--dm-plum'), ochre = css('--dm-ochre'), bg = css('--dm-bg');
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, g.w, g.h);
    for (var i = 0; i < M; i++) for (var j = 0; j < M; j++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = mix(lo, hi, 0.08 + 0.8 * psi.rank[i][j]);
      ctx.fillRect(g.x0 + j * g.cell + 1, g.y0 + i * g.cell + 1, g.cell - 2, g.cell - 2);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = muted; ctx.font = '12px "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText("player 2's action", g.x0 + M * g.cell / 2, g.y0 + M * g.cell + 15);
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(g.x0 - 8, g.y0 + M * g.cell / 2); ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2); ctx.fillText("player 1's action", 0, 0); ctx.restore();

    var cyc = outcome === 'cycle' ? path.slice(cycleAt, cycleAt + 2) : [];
    var special = cyc.length === 2 ? [[cyc[0][0], cyc[1][1]], [cyc[1][0], cyc[0][1]]] : [];
    ne.forEach(function (p) {
      var c = centre(g, p), isSpecial = special.some(function (q) { return q[0] === p[0] && q[1] === p[1]; });
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c[0], c[1], g.cell * 0.36, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.strokeStyle = isSpecial ? ochre : ink; ctx.lineWidth = isSpecial ? 3 : 1.6; ctx.stroke();
    });

    var start = Math.max(0, path.length - 8);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = plum;
    for (var k = start + 1; k < path.length; k++) {
      var a = centre(g, path[k - 1]), b = centre(g, path[k]);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 + 0.75 * (k - start) / (path.length - start);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); ctx.lineTo(b[0], b[1]); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    if (path.length > 1) {
      var prev = centre(g, path[path.length - 2]);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(prev[0], prev[1], g.cell * 0.17, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.strokeStyle = plum; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
    }
    var cur = centre(g, path[path.length - 1]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cur[0], cur[1], g.cell * 0.2, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fillStyle = plum; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = bg; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();

    var t = path.length - 1;
    if (!statusEl) return;
    var when = cycleAt === 0 ? 'from the start' : 'after ' + cycleAt + ' round' + (cycleAt === 1 ? '' : 's');
    if (outcome === 'ne') statusEl.textContent = cycleAt === 0 ? 'Started at a pure Nash equilibrium.' : 'Reached a pure Nash equilibrium ' + when + '.';
    else if (outcome === 'cycle') statusEl.textContent = 'Trapped in a 2-cycle ' + when + ': the players keep missing the two equilibria ringed in yellow.';
    else statusEl.textContent = 'Round ' + t + '.';
  }

  function size() {
    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), d = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(r.width * d); canvas.height = Math.round(r.height * d);
    ctx.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, 0, 0); draw();
  }

  function run() {
    clearInterval(timer); clearTimeout(timer);
    newGame();
    if (reduce) { for (var s = 0; s < 40 && !outcome; s++) advance(); advance(); draw(); return; }
    draw();
    var extra = 0;
    timer = setInterval(function () {
      advance(); draw();
      if (outcome && ++extra > 5) { clearInterval(timer); timer = setTimeout(run, 4500); }
    }, 900);
  }

  document.getElementById('sbrd-new').addEventListener('click', run);
  canvas.addEventListener('click', run);
  if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(size).observe(canvas); else window.addEventListener('resize', size);
  new MutationObserver(draw).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
  run(); size();
})();
</script>
```
